title: Three years to get a bloom /plant
text: Three years to get a bloom /plant. these never grew when all of the other alliums  I purchased this year grew like mad, I was looking forward to these  Here it is 2017 and I actually have this bloom....I still will not give it over a two star because 3 years is a long time to wait for a plant to grow the photo below is this years bloom from these bulbs

product_metadata.title: Red Mohican Allium 2 Bulbs - 10/+ cm - Deep Red Blooms and Fragrant
features: Mature Height: 36-40" tall. Excellent for naturalizing.
Bloom Time: Early summer. Bulb size: 10/+ cm
description: Create a unique, colorful statement with this Allium. Red Mohican boasts smaller, deep red blooms that are sweetly-fragrant. Makes for unusual bouquets!
